persistent.transient_fbw: 5 owners each two_history[4], three_history[6], peak_statistics[18], previous_mean F32, short_queue[4] I1, other_queue[4] I1
persistent.primary_transform: 5 FBW x128 F32 plus LFE x128 F32
persistent.companion_transform: 5 FBW x128 F32 plus LFE x128 F32; distinct from primary
persistent.previous_short: 5 I1, last consumed block of prior source
persistent.gain_db_policy: F09 declared gain peak/db selector and authorized policy state

per_source_scratch.converter_plan: five frame codes plus converter SNR offset, derived independently from POWER snapshot
per_source_scratch.trial: candidate q, BAP rows, mantissa codes, scratch bitwriter; never persistent

commit: one source commit installs F07/F08/F09 next state, codec transform next state and previous_short only after final 4096-byte frame succeeds
failure: candidate failure changes search bounds only; fatal source failure records before/after canonical SHA-256 for lifecycle,input_history,transient,primary_companion_lfe,policy,codec,previous_short,publication; only lifecycle retired bit may differ
canonical_digest: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true and separators comma/colon over the owner projection named by the r2 vector; integers are JSON decimal and booleans are lowercase JSON literals
reset: all persistent families cold and source index0; reset state equals cold state field-for-field and source0 replay equals cold source0 core output

canonical_encoding.name: F07_F12_OWNER_STATE_V5
canonical_encoding.rule: Each owner is the field-complete JSON object defined by owner_shapes; previous_short is exactly {i1_words:[5 I1]}; UTF-8 sorted keys comma/colon separators finite numbers only; no generation-only projection.
canonical_encoding.fatal_rule: all-candidate-fail may change lifecycle only; every other complete owner digest before/after must match
canonical_encoding.reset_rule: reset_state object must equal cold_state object field-for-field

audio_owner_projection.policy_gain_db_history_u32_words: external channel LFE (input channel index3), delayed_audio[3][1472:1536], each value squared then rounded once to binary32, serialize 64 U32 little-endian bit patterns in increasing sample index
audio_owner_projection.codec_transform_history_u32_words: external channel L (input channel index0), delayed_audio[0][1280:1536], serialize 256 binary32 U32 bit patterns in increasing sample index
audio_owner_projection.flattening: channel selection occurs before slicing; no cross-channel flatten is permitted
audio_owner_projection.successful_generation: input/transient/transform/policy generations each advance once during staged numeric work; codec generation advances once and bitwriter_cursor becomes32768 only after a successful complete frame
audio_owner_projection.fatal_staged: input/transient/transform/policy staged generations advance and their arrays contain attempted source values; codec staged samples contain attempted external-L delayed[1280:1536], while codec generation and cursor retain committed values; committed after equals before outside lifecycle
audio_owner_projection.publication: accepted source>=2 appends exactly {au:source-2,payloads:input payloads}; suppressed or fatal source appends nothing
